AboutForm_lblDescription: A desktop application for downloading videos from iwara.tv.
BulkImportForm_lblDescription: Enter iwara.tv / iwara.ai video or channel URLs (one URL per line)
BulkImportForm_lblHelp:
* Supported: video URLs / channel (profile) URLs / bare VideoIds (both iwara.tv and iwara.ai)
* Duplicate URLs are skipped automatically
DuplicateCheckForm_lblDescription: Detects identical videos (same VideoId) that exist in multiple channels.
ImportFromFolderWizard_lblStep1Desc: Scans mp4/m4v files in the selected folder and identifies videos
ImportFromFolderWizard_lblStep3Title: Select authors to register as channels
ImportFromFolderWizard_lblStep3Desc: Checked authors will be added as subscribed channels.
MainForm_btnAddUser_Tip: Add a subscribed channel (username / profile URL)
MainForm_btnAddVideo_Tip: Add a single video URL to the queue
MainForm_btnCheckNow_Tip: Check subscribed channels for new videos now (F5)
MainForm_btnClipMonitor_Tip: Clipboard monitor: automatically queue iwara URLs
MainForm_btnSettings_Tip: Save folder, quality, notifications, rate limits and more
MainForm_btnSetup_Tip: Setup wizard for Python and dependencies
MainForm_btnLogin_Tip: Log in with your iwara account (required for search and DL)
SettingsForm_lblMinFreeSpaceNote: GB — downloads won't start below this (0 = disabled)
SettingsForm_chkAutoDownload: Start downloading automatically when new videos are found
SettingsForm_chkDownloadExternal: Also download external videos (YouTube embeds etc.) — can be overridden per channel
SettingsForm_lblPythonNote: * If setup has already been completed, only the path is changed (no library reinstall needed)
SettingsForm_lblYtDlpNote: * "yt-dlp" (from PATH) is fine. If not installed, pip install is attempted automatically
SettingsForm_lblAccountNote:
* Logging in with an iwara account is required to download
   R-18 content and private videos.
* After changing email/password, click "Re-login".
SettingsForm_chkExponentialBackoff: Enable exponential backoff (increase wait time on consecutive errors)
SettingsForm_lblAdvancedNote:
* Rate limit settings reduce server load and prevent 403/429 errors.
* Values that are too small may get your access restricted.
* Values that are too large slow down downloads.
SettingsForm_chkEnableSound: Play a sound when a download completes
SettingsForm_chkEnableErrorSound: Play a sound when a download fails
SettingsForm_lblMigrationNote:
Writes iwara UUID tags into previously downloaded video files.
Tagged files can be re-discovered even after DB loss or renaming.
SettingsForm_chkWebBindAll: Allow access from other devices on the LAN
SetupWizardForm_lblWelcomeDesc: This wizard will automatically set up the following requirements:
